clauses.mechanism: express revocation in the preamble of EO 13350 ('I hereby terminate the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12722, revoke that Executive Order and Executive Order 12724 of August 9, 1990, Executive Order 12734 of November 14, 1990, ... that are based on that national emergency'); EO 13350 sec. 10: 'This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July 30, 2004' (signed July 29, 2004; 69 FR 46055, printed July 30, 2004)
clauses.reason: Whole order (one paragraph): invokes the emergency construction authority at 10 U.S.C. 2808 and makes it available to the Secretary of Defense and, at his discretion, the military department Secretaries, in support of the national emergency declared by EO 12722 (Iraq); effective immediately on signing 1990-11-14. The order has no term, sunset or report deadline (no own-term kinds). The invocation depends on the emergency declared in EO 12722; EO 13350 terminated that emergency and revoked EO 12734 by name, effective 12:01 a.m. EDT 2004-07-30 (sec. 10, not the signing date 2004-07-29). No earlier end appears in the held texts: the 2001 invocation of the same authority in EO 13235 rests on a different emergency (Proclamation 7463) and does not touch this order.

savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_13350 (EO 13350, 69 FR 46055-46057, read once in full; Annex pages are images): sec. 1 provides, under NEA sec. 202(a), that termination of the emergency declared in EO 12722 'shall not affect any action taken or proceeding pending but not finally concluded or determined as of the effective date of this order, any action or proceeding based on any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties that matured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date'; the preamble revokes EO 12734 as one of the orders 'based on that national emergency', so the clause reaches it. Own-residual check, reading EO 12734 in full: it invoked 10 U.S.C. 2808 for the Secretary of Defense and the military department Secretaries, so construction projects authorized and funds obligated under that authority before 2004-07-30 are actions taken under the order that the savings clause preserves; the order itself created no new office, right or fund. S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) OVERRULED to transferred_or_accrued: the prefill found no savings wording, but sec. 1 of the acting order is a savings clause that reaches this order. Bounded search: EO 12722, 12724, 12734, 13235 and 13350 in full; a by-number scan of all held FR-original texts; the three machine searches. The annual presidential continuation notices of the Iraq emergency are notices, not orders, and are not held.

research_rationale: EO 12734 (signed 1990-11-14, 55 FR 48099), read in full from the held FR text, is a single paragraph that invokes the emergency construction authority at 10 U.S.C. 2808 in support of the national emergency declared in EO 12722 (Iraq) and takes effect immediately; it has no term, sunset or report deadline. EO 13350 (69 FR 46055, read in full; reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_13350.json) terminates that emergency and, in its preamble, revokes EO 12722, 12724, 12734, 12743, 12751 and 12817 as based on it; sec. 10 makes it effective at 12:01 a.m. EDT on July 30, 2004, so the first end is 2004-07-30. Dossier leads 'target provision not located: EO:12722' and '... EO:12724' resolved: EO 12722 (55 FR 31803, held FR text) declared the emergency and EO 12724 (55 FR 33089) imposed sanctions; neither mentions EO 12734 or 10 U.S.C. 2808 and both predate it, so both are ruled out as events on this order. EO 13235 (66 FR 58343, 2001) invokes the same statutory authority for the 2001 emergency and does not name EO 12734, so it is ruled out. A by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 12734 named only in EO 13350. The dossier's single 'whole' clause covers the entire operative paragraph. Limit: the annual continuation notices keeping the emergency alive to 2004 are not orders and are not held; EO 13350 itself recites that the emergency was still in force, and no held source records an earlier end. Savings: the S0 prefill is overruled, see savings_residuals.
